messages.subject: base funs for stanc into stanc_helper w/o std::cerr, std::cout
parts:
I pushed a change to stanc that breaks out a helper
function in file stan/command/stanc_helper.hpp that
has the stanc main() functionality but takes arguments
for output and error streams (these can be the same
or set to 0).

I hope this is enough to get rid of the warnings
Jiqiang's getting on the R side.

- Bob
